sentences.text: Having heard the learned counsel for the Petitioners and the learned Agp for the

, we find that admittedly, the land acquisition award in
the present case was passed as far back as on 25/08/1989.
2.  The Petitioners filed their applications under Section 30 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, after 30 years on 02/12/2019.

In the reply affidavit, the Respondent No. 2 has categorically stated that the amount of compensation determined under the award dated 25/08/1989 stood disbursed to land owners i.e. the branch of Namdeo and his successors as far back as on 02/01/1990.

sentences.text: It is also come on record that some of the family members of the family, to which the Petitioners belong, had invoked Section 28A of the varsha 1 of 2 18-wp-7814-2025.doc said Act, which resulted in an award dated 08/07/2016.

4. It is contended on behalf of the Petitioner that as much as Section 30 of the aforesaid Act would apply to an award under Section 11 of the said Act, it ought to apply even to an award passed by the Collector under Section 28A thereof.

5. On this basis, it is submitted that the applications filed by the Petitioners on 02/12/2019 under Section 30 of the said Act ought to have been considered by the Respondent No. 2.
6.

The learned AGP submits that short adjournment be granted so that she would respond to the said contention raised on behalf of the Petitioners and that relevant judgments shall be placed before this Court for perusal.
7. List on 25th March 2026, 'High on Board'.
